majors.issue: Road fill is a strong blue-teal diagonal argyle/zigzag hatch that repeats every 16 px along the road (horizontal 16px-shift diff 7.3 vs ~20 for dirt); reads as a knitted pattern, not asphalt. Road meets dirt with a dead-straight hard cut, no curb, shoulder, crumbled edge or cracks/lane remnants. Hue is off-family vs modern-city's grey flat asphalt.
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r2-C/s1-road.png (whole road band), settlement-1.png y208-240; ruined-city-2/5 grid roads
majors.fix: Redraw asphalt as grey low-contrast clustered fill with 2-3 variants placed non-periodically, add broken edge/curb autotile pieces, faded lane paint and cracks/potholes integrated into the surface.

majors.target: wasteland_ruins dirt ground (dirt-a/dirt-b) on all 6 wasteland maps
majors.issue: Ground repeats exactly with a 64 px period (64px-shift diff 3.7-8.8 vs ~18 at other offsets on shanty-6/shanty-3/settlement-1); the dark dimples of dirt-b line up in evenly spaced rows across open areas. Base texture is per-pixel salt-and-pepper speckle (TV static) rather than clustered clods like Beodeul or flat fills like modern-city.
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r2-C/sh6-dirt.png (rows of dimples at equal spacing), /tmp/vqa-r2-C/dirtz.png; g-dirt-field2x.png 64px period
majors.fix: Randomise variant placement per cell (hash, not 4x4 block), reduce dimple frequency/make them rare overlays, rework base into clustered 3-4 tone patches with less single-pixel noise.

majors.target: settlement-1 vs settlement-4; ruined-city-2 vs ruined-city-5
majors.issue: Different seeds produce the same template: settlement = E-W road with a top row of ruins + N-S road + rectangular wall compound with a slab yard, 3-4 shacks above, 2 stalls + log/campfire inside, water towers, generator; ruined-city = identical 3x3 block grid with roads at the same x/y in both seeds. A player visiting both would see reskins.
majors.evidence: settlement-1.png vs settlement-4.png full view; ruined-city-2.png vs ruined-city-5.png roads at x~245/565, y~215/435 in both
majors.fix: Vary macro layout per seed (road count/orientation, diagonal/broken roads, compound shape and position, block sizes, collapsed blocks/craters, open squares).

majors.issue: Perimeter is built from identical wall-h stamps each with peaked end caps, so the wall reads as a row of identical tiny bunkers with notches between; wall-v segments have visible gaps between every piece. Isolated wall-h pieces float outside the compound.
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r2-C/s1-compound.png top row and left column; orphan piece settlement-1.png ~(673,533), settlement-4.png ~(385,535)
majors.fix: Make wall an autotile with continuous middle segments, caps only at true ends and broken gaps where intended; drop stray segments or attach them to something.

majors.issue: Repeated identical stamps: shanty-3 has 4-5 pixel-identical rusty shacks (same roof patch, same door), shanty-6 has ~8 identical teal tarp shelters; layout is a uniform scatter on an empty dirt field with no lanes, fences, yards or clustering - reads as a sprite dump rather than a town.
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r2-C/sh3.png (three identical shacks right column), shanty-6.png tarps
majors.fix: Add shack/tarp variants (or recolour/flip/attachments), group dwellings along paths and around shared features, add fences/scrap walls/alleys.

majors.issue: The temple flagstone yard is the same stamp in both seeds: small shrine top-left, column right, fallen wall block left, central temple, column pair, cypress on the right, all in the same relative positions. Only the yard position changes.
majors.fix: Compose the temple precinct procedurally (number/placement of columns, collapsed sections, altar, steps, overgrowth) per seed.

majors.issue: Forest masses end with stair-stepped hard rectangular cuts: canopies sliced flat, a straight horizontal strip of shadowed tree bases, and half trees at the block boundary.
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r2-C/m7-yard.png right side (x~740-1080 in crop = map x~850-960, y~390-560); /tmp/vqa-r2-C/t5.png right side (map x~585-640, y~450-640)
majors.fix: Use the organic forest-edge pieces / scatter single trees along the edge; never cut canopy at cell boundaries.

majors.issue: Grass fill shows a faint repeating glyph-like mark (reads like 'Snge') on a tight grid across every open grass area - visible at 1x on light grass.
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r2-C/grass.png (mining-7 x700-960,y80-200), also visible in t2.png and v3-yard.png borders
majors.fix: Remove the repeating mark from the grass base tile or break it with random variants.

minors.issue: Every seam T-junction carries the same brown chip; looks mechanical. Slab field repeats every 128 px.
Slab rectangle ends with a hard straight edge onto dirt, no border/broken edge; stalls overhang its south edge.
Brick piles placed partly over building roof edges and husks overlapping slab edges; scrap/brick confetti spread evenly over the whole map instead of clustering near ruins.
minors.fix: Collision-check overlays against buildings; cluster debris near collapse sites.

minors.issue: Bright saturated green round bushes (Beodeul-like) look out of place in an irradiated wasteland palette.

Mining town identity is carried by one small yard; rest of map is farm fields and pines identical to other quarter villages. Yards in both seeds hold the same prop set (derrick, adit, ore rock, cart).
minors.fix: Add spoil heaps, rail tracks, ore carts, workers' huts; vary props.

minors.issue: Winery building and vine-row block are the same stamp; v3 repeats the identical vine block twice.
Puddles read as black pits (no rim/highlight); confusing next to the black pothole stamps.
minors.fix: Add lighter rim, sky reflection highlight.

pieceNotes.wasteland_ruins/dirt-a: base speckle noise + 64px periodic tiling visible on maps
pieceNotes.wasteland_ruins/dirt-b: dimples form evenly spaced rows on maps (64px period)
pieceNotes.wasteland_ruins/rubble-b: red brick lump is an undefined noisy blob: no top plane/front split, no outline or contact shadow (rubble-c has them)
pieceNotes.wasteland_ruins/puddle: flat dark blob, no rim or reflection; reads as a hole
